facts.text: John mentioned that he helped renovate a rundown community center back home last year.

evidence.quote: I haven't been able to volunteer much lately, but I definitely care about it. Last year, I helped renovate a rundown community center back home.

facts.text: John expressed that seeing the impact on the community from the renovation was worth the effort.

evidence.quote: It took a lot of work, but seeing the impact on the community was so worth it.

facts.text: John described the renovation as an event where everyone came together to help out.

evidence.quote: It was really cool to see everyone come together and help out.

facts.text: Maria praised John's volunteer work and acknowledged the positive effect it had on the community.

evidence.quote: John, that's great! Must be really satisfying to witness the positive effect it's having on your hometown.
